item.text:
Added React view transitions to the gallery. Each thumbnail and its detail hero now share a named transition for the image morph. Gallery and detail links use Next.js transition types for forward and back slides, while Suspense skeletons fade and slide into content. The CSS disables these animations and the skeleton pulse when `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` is set.

I upgraded React and React DOM to 19.3.1, which provides `ViewTransition`. The implementation is in [ProductGrid.tsx](/workspace/app/ProductGrid.tsx:9), [PageTransition.tsx](/workspace/app/PageTransition.tsx:1), the [detail page](/workspace/app/product/[slug]/page.tsx:40), and [globals.css](/workspace/app/globals.css:113).

**Verified:** `npm run build` passes. HTTP checks returned 200 for the gallery and a product page, and 404 for an unknown product. The animation itself has not been visually checked in a browser.
